definitions.explanation: The national tax on alcoholic drinks, charged at different rates for beer, wine, sake, shōchū and other categories. Its rates explain why Japanese brewers created cheaper beer-like drinks such as {発泡酒|はっぽうしゅ}.

examples.japanese: {酒税|しゅぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酒税|しゅぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{含|ふく}まれている→含む：01982_fukumu⟧。
examples.english: The price of beer includes the liquor tax.

examples.japanese: {酒税|しゅぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦ビール→ビール：01015_biiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{発泡酒|はっぽうしゅ}→発泡酒：33170_happoushu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{税率|ぜいりつ}→税率：28616_zeiritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{小|ちい}さく→小さい：00025_chiisai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: With the revision of the liquor tax, the gap in tax rates between beer and happōshu narrowed.

notes:
⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (alcohol) + ⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax). Paid by the brewer or importer and built into the shop price, unlike ⟦{消費税|しょうひぜい}→消費税：04803_shouhizei⟧, which is added on top.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {酒税法|しゅぜいほう}: the Liquor Tax Act, which also defines what counts as an alcoholic drink
- {酒税|しゅぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧: a revision of the liquor tax
- {酒税|しゅぜい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げ→引き上げ：12552_hikiage⟧ / ⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ→引き下げ：12553_hikisage⟧: a rise / cut in the liquor tax
